sloka: विददार नखैः अस्य तुण्डम् पृष्ठे समर्पयन् ।केशान् च उत्पाटयामास नख पक्ष मुख आयुधः ॥३-५१-३५॥
transliteration: vidadāra nakhaiḥ asya tuṇḍam pṛṣṭhe samarpayan ।keśān ca utpāṭayāmāsa nakha pakṣa mukha āyudhaḥ ॥3-51-35॥

translations.english: Jatayu who had his claws, wings and beak as the only weapons pierced and pricked Ravana all over with his nails by pressing his beak on his back and pulled out his hair.
